title: Type Size Relationship
slide_intent: Keep differences in emphasis large enough that readers can recognize the information hierarchy at a glance.
strategic_value: A controlled reduction from headline to subhead to body can make Burger King messages easier to scan without changing type families.
demonstration: Headline, Subhead and Body Copy sit on a shared baseline with horizontal measurement guides and a written 50% relationship.
practical_value: Compare visible ascender and cap heights rather than assuming every relationship is a percentage of font point size.

content_islands.name: Ratio explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the short rule at upper left.

content_islands.name: Measured hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Arrange the three role words across the center with guide lines showing their relative heights.

ingredient.name: Type-role size relationship
ingredient.role: Make the headline lead and supporting levels recede.
ingredient.application: For layouts using all three typefaces, cap subhead height at 50% of headline ascender height and body height at 50% of subhead cap height.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. These are the source’s glyph-height measures, not a blanket 50% point-size rule.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy connects these limits to establishing clear hierarchy.
reference_purposes.Application: The diagram relates three type roles through measurable heights.
reference_purposes.Constraint: When all three faces are used, subheads are no larger than 50% of headline ascender height; body is no larger than 50% of subhead cap height.
